Nora: Planning a Dedicated rollout for Oakmont Systems tonight 22:15 PT. Aim: warm reserved pool, run parity checks on golden prompts, and pin runtime to v2026-03-stable before final promote. Need SRE + Ops ack and a short smoke window at 100% before committing. @Ethan @Ravi
DeployBot: [deploybot] Scheduled rollout: oakmont-dedicated-vpin -> 2026-03-21T22:15:00-07:00. Canary stages: 10% (10m) -> 40% (10m) -> 100% (15m). RunID db-roll-1766667777. Preflight started.
Ethan: Quick ask: what are the automated rollback thresholds and the manual-approval policy? want to lock this down to avoid noisy alarms.
Nora: Rollback triggers are: (1) p99 latency increases >125ms above baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets; (2) request error rate >0.9% sustained for 4m; (3) semantic regression on golden set >1.8% absolute. Auto-halt + revert on triggers. Manual rollback requires two approvers (one SRE, one Ops). Documented in runbook.
Ravi: SRE: add a 90s settle period after each stage before evaluating p99 to avoid false positives from KV churn. Also will run a 30-sample golden eval at each stage boundary: `redwoodctl eval --tenant oakmont --golden 30`.
DeployBot: Preflight summary for db-roll-1766667777:
```
- capacity-check: reserved pool 1.18x -> OK
- smoke-tests: 9/9 passed
- kms-status: OK
- kv-warm-probe: scheduled at canary start
- canary-policy: 10 -> 40 -> 100
```
Clara: Ops note: tenant key rotation for Oakmont is scheduled in 72h, so no overlap. Ops will still toggle a temporary KMS hold before final promote as precaution: `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant oakmont --until 2026-03-23`. I'll be on keyboard for KMS toggle if needed.
Ethan: I added an emergency rollback CLI snippet to runbook with force-drain: `redwoodctl rollback --tenant oakmont --to-version v2026.02.x --force --run-id db-roll-1766667777`. Also added a short checklist for post-mortem data to capture: prefix-hit curve, KV warm timeline, and per-slice small-signal latency.
Ravi: ACK SRE. I'll watch p99, prefix-hit rate, and golden-diff. Oncall will be present.
Clara: Ops ACK. KMS hold owner assigned.
Nora: Final GO/NO-GO at 21:55 PT. We want a 5-minute smoke window at 100% where we run parity sampler and confirm no drift before marking the rollout done. If green for 5m, Ops may release KMS hold after 24h.
DeployBot: Notifications queued to oncall channels. Canary will start at 2026-03-21T22:15:00-07:00.
Ethan: GO from SRE.
Clara: GO from Ops.
Nora: Thanks all. DeployBot proceed as scheduled and auto-halt on triggers. I'll open the channel during the window for live updates. Post-roll notes: capture KV warm time and initial p50/p95/p99 spike profiles. Reopen thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
